purpose: Teach: 技師/舗装/練り/降ろし/耐震/ドラッグ/併用/学位

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、技師、絶対、人材、絶対、補強しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need our engineering team strengthened. This is serious. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Sharp, clipped delivery. Each phrase lands with weight. No apology in the voice. Direct eye contact. Spine straight. The tone of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場前、本気で、絶対、舗装、絶対、工事、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The factory paving project is moving ahead. We appreciate your confidence in us.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Slight formality in posture. Steady pace, no rushing. Each point acknowledged with quiet competence. A nod threaded through the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 戦略、本気で、絶対、練り、絶対、直せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Rework the strategy. Get it right this time. I need it done.
lines.style: Crisper than the first line. A trace of frustration underneath—not anger, but the edge of impatience. Lean forward slightly. Fast clip on the directives.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い在庫、本気で、絶対、降ろし、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're clearing out the old inventory and moving forward. Thank you for your direction.
lines.style: Same respectful baseline as line two, but with a thread of urgency. Faster clip than before—keeping pace. Shoulders slightly forward, as if pushing into the work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新社屋、本気で、絶対、耐震、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The new headquarters—I need the seismic reinforcement verified. Make sure it's done.
lines.style: Return to the commanding tone of line one. Slower, more deliberate. Each word placed with precision. A pause before the final demand. No room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、ドラッグ、絶対、ストア、絶対、展開、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're currently evaluating the rollout of our new drugstore locations. We're grateful for your guidance.
lines.style: The same measured competence as lines two and four, but with a thread of ambition underneath. Slight lift in energy—this is a bigger project. Steady breath, steady voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 販促、本気で、絶対、併用、絶対、戦略、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Run the promotional strategy alongside the new locations. Make it work together.
lines.style: Firm but slightly less sharp than the seismic line. This is a strategic note, not a rebuke. Even delivery. A pause between the two directives—giving each one breathing room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、学位、絶対、取得、絶対、応援、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively supporting our staff in pursuing further qualifications. Thank you for the opportunity to continue growing.
lines.style: Warmest of Kenji's responses—a subtle shift. Still professional, but there's genuine appreciation in the pacing. Slower, more human. A breath of relief at the end.
